messages:
kevin: Postmortem follow-up: we had ~1.8% partial-stream responses during the 08:10 window. I wrote up a short remediation plan, need owners + deadlines.
anya: Thanks. Root-cause notes: proxy TCP FIN + mid-stream windowed writes from model worker -> client saw truncated chunked frames. Also saw client reconnect without checking last-ack id.
sam: Got it. From SDK side we should add idempotency checks + a small sliding buffer to reassemble partial chunks. I can add logic to validate sequence numbers on reconnect.
marta: From runtime we can change final flush semantics to ensure an application-level EOM frame and atomically close after ACK if possible. Might need small model runtime change.
raj: Infra: increase proxy idle timeout from 30s -> 90s for streaming routes and add periodic keepalive pings. Will run canary config on infra-canary.
kevin: Cool. Propose owners: SDK seq-checks + tests -> @sam (RINF-4330), runtime EOM frame -> @marta (RINF-4331), proxy keepalive -> @raj (RINF-4332). Add obs/alerts -> who can own?
anya: I'll add a metric "stream.eom_not_seen" and alert if >0.5% per 10m. Also add a dashboard with last-ack distribution and reconnect frequency. ETA 6h.
sre-oncall: I'll wire the alert into oncall runbook. Pager if sustained >1% for 15m. Playbook: roll proxy config back, disable runtime EOM feature-flag, and open P0 channel.
kevin: Timelines please?
sam: SDK PR by Tue EOD, unit + integration tests Thu, release Canary Friday. I'll keep backward compatibility so old clients don't break.
marta: Runtime patch is small but touches model worker flush path. I'll do a gated rollout behind feature-flag. PR by Mon, canary 10% Tue, full rollout Wed if green.
raj: Proxy canary tonight 11pm UTC on infra-canary -> 12h monitor. Full rollout in 48h if no regressions.
anya: Also adding synthetic test to repro FIN mid-stream (repo: infra/stream-fuzz). Will add to nightly CI and link to incident.
kevin: Good. Two cross-cutting items: customer comms and regression detection for recurring pattern. @marta can you and @anya validate old logs for similar spikes? If recurring, we need an ongoing mitigation (circuit breaker or more conservative defaults).
marta: Will run a 90d query and report back by tomorrow. If we see recurring spikes, propose defaulting keepalive to 60s on all streaming routes.
anya: I found 3 previous small spikes on 2025-11-08, 2026-01-12, and today. Pattern looks monthly-ish, probably NATs / ISP churn.
sam: For clients: implement tolerance window and checksum, and a client opt-in to strict-mode once servers advertise EOM. That avoids breaking old SDKs.
kevin: Ops: compile a customer-impact list. @raj if proxy change reduces partials we should reach out proactively to the 4 affected accounts.
raj: Will prepare a list and coordinate with CSMs. ETA for list: 2h.
sre-oncall: Deploy-bot: starting proxy canary at 1779943350 on infra-canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated (config keepalive=90s) for route /v1/stream. logs: https://deploys/redwood/1779943350
kevin: Great. I'll update the incident doc with owners/tickets and schedule a 1-week checkpoint. If alert fires before then, we triage immediately. Closing here when PRs are linked. :thumbsup:
anya: Linking tickets now: RINF-4330, RINF-4331, RINF-4332. Also adding retro checklist items: test harness, canary window, customer notification template.
sam: Noted. I'll add SDK compatibility matrix to the ticket.
marta: Adding integration test to simulate FIN mid-stream and verify EOM handshake.
kevin: thanks all — standup update tomorrow.
